question.prompt: At Annville Junior High School, \(30\%\) of the students in the Math Club are in the Science Club, and \(80\%\) of the students in the Science Club are in the Math Club. There are \(15\) students in the Science Club. How many students are in the Math Club?

solutions.explanation:
Both percentages describe the same group: students who belong to both clubs. First use the Science Club's known membership to count that group. Since \(80\%\) of its \(15\) students also belong to the Math Club, there are
\[
0.80\times15=12
\]
students in both clubs.

These \(12\) students are \(30\%\) of the Math Club. Dividing the known part by its percentage gives the whole membership:
\[
12\div0.30=40.
\]
The Math Club has \(40\) students, choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
solutions.title: Count the students in both clubs
